value.name: stop fearing each other
value.description: After a long winter, the people involved finally stop being afraid of one another.
evidence: finally, after a long winter, stopped being afraid of each other.

evidence: She went down the three stone steps

value.name: turn toward Walnut Street
value.description: She turns toward Walnut Street as she departs.

value.description: With the file now feeling light under her arm, she walks home.

value.name: reflect on estate's dual outcome
value.description: While walking home, she thinks that some estates close and some open, and that this one managed to do both.
evidence: thinking, against her rule and entirely within it, that some estates closed and some opened, and that this one, against considerable odds, had managed to do both.
